hero.subtitle: Junior full-stack developer, application designer & developer. I design, I code, I iterate - until the interface looks obvious.

about.title: At a glance
about.body: I'm Baptiste Dechamp, a junior full-stack JS/TS developer holding the French Application Designer & Developer certification (RNCP level 6). I build web, mobile and desktop apps with React, TypeScript and Node, from architecture to production. Adaptable, analytical and a good listener, I look for the why before the how, and my product sense comes from a multidisciplinary path.
